title: A Musical Hat Happening: Princess Wow's Smile Revolution
description: Mindy Fradkin, aka Princess Wow, and musician Roland Moussa in an hour-long musical fashion show of songs, stories and handcrafted hats.
imageAlt: Mindy Fradkin, aka Princess Wow, in one of her handcrafted hats, with Roland Moussa (photo: Jim Metzger)
about: Mindy Fradkin, aka Princess Wow, and multi-talented musician Roland Moussa entertain and enlighten with a grown-up version of dress-up. With their playful spirits, they bring hats, accessories, fantasy and songs to Holland Tunnel Gallery.

In this hour-long, soulful and lively musical fashion show, the duo sings as one voice, tells fun and fascinating stories, and gets the audience singing and enjoying Mindy's exquisite handcrafted hats. A $10 suggested donation at the door supported the artists.
